evidence: Walked instruction.md and both notes line by line against solution/app; every asked-for screen, role and flow has an implementation. VIEWS: staff get Board, Conversations and Activity; candidates get only 'My applications' (app.js:87-91; threads.js:27,226; board.js:344-348; app.js:45-85). Sign-in/sign-out for all 10 seeded accounts with Hireops!2026 (index.js:84-101; db.js:122-147). AUTH/ROLES: 401 without session, 403 wrong role, 404 for a candidate's foreign application (index.js:73-81,121-131,326-333,378-385). JOBS/CANDIDATES (rules s2): recruiter-only open job, HM chosen from hiring-manager accounts, places 1-50 (index.js:202-214; board.js:61-81); add candidate at bottom of Applied, email shape and case-insensitive per-job duplicate refused at the field with typed values kept (index.js:216-233; board.js:47-60); candidate-account emails link the application (index.js:225). BOARD (s3): one-step moves, reject needs a reason and never from Hired, reopen only to rejected_from and clears the reason (index.js:238-265,311-314); per-card select+Move controls, Up/Down reorder, optional drag with drop position (board.js:208-244,300-319); shared persisted order (index.js:199-200); Interview cap counted for the whole set (index.js:290-295); HM limited to own job and Interview/Offer/Hired incl. reject/reopen (index.js:257-264; board.js:144-162). CONCURRENCY: per-card version; stale move 409 naming who via the latest activity line (index.js:241-245); optimistic move shown at once, put back with the reason and focus kept on the card's controls, then refresh (board.js:166-205). BULK: 2-50 cards in board order (stage then position), all-or-nothing in one immediate transaction (index.js:274-321,339-344; board.js:285-290). UNDO: own latest action only, single use, restores stage, place and reason, refused if any card's version changed or Interview would overfill (index.js:165-168,348-373; board.js:291-299). NOTES: detail panel with internal notes; recruiter any card, HM own jobs, observer read-only; unsaved note kept per user per card (index.js:386-398; board.js:85-141). ACTIVITY (s4): lines for open/add/move/reject with reason/reopen/reorder/undo written inside the same transactions so refusals leave none; newest first; All jobs or one job (index.js:189,195-198,211,230,315-316,366; app.js:45-85). LIVE (s5): SSE 'changed' after every successful write incl. read markers; client refreshes and patches keyed nodes in place preserving focus, typing, open card and scroll (index.js:45-54,102-107; app.js:138-172; board.js:321-341; threads.js:36-65). CONVERSATIONS (s6): access per role (index.js:114-120); Enter sends, Shift+Enter newline, box cleared and focused, failed send kept with an error (threads.js:184-202); line breaks via pre-wrap (styles.css:105); newest 30 scrolled to bottom, earlier 30 at a time with remaining count and scroll anchoring (index.js:401-417; threads.js:85-87,161-176); arrival while scrolled up keeps place, shows 'N new messages' and stays unread (threads.js:146-160); per-person unread plus nav total (index.js:132-139; threads.js:225; app.js:120-129); seen receipts incl. observer exclusion (index.js:143-150; threads.js:76-83); drafts per user per conversation across switch, reload and session loss, invisible to others (app.js:38-43,195-203; threads.js:113,125,183). CANDIDATE (s7): own applications with job title, team, candidate wording and unread; nothing opened on sign-in; no notes, reason, rejected_from, position or activity in candidate payloads (index.js:171-176; threads.js:7,52-53). RUNTIME: node /app/server.js, PORT, health served before DB by the listener thread, DB_PATH, seed beside module, seed once (server.js; bootstrap.js:18-24,43; db.js:70-71,123; solve.sh). RUNTIME CORROBORATION: qc/repairs/hireops-2026-10-03-workspace/results/workspace.json (sha256 662829b4... verified; index says rerun 8 Oct 2026 against the frozen solution bytes, and I re-verified all 12 source hashes) reports 26/26 scripted groups passed, incl. stale move naming who, bulk+undo through the page, live board arrival_ms 799 with note draft and focus kept, conversation paging/anchoring, session-ended draft, observer read-only, restart durability and no page errors. Scripted golden evidence only; not a configured judge run, Oracle grade or model score. LESSONS FILE: patterns bearing on this row checked. Lesson 1 (hidden requirements) is the reverse direction (rows 4/27/31); no brief demand lacks an implementation. Lesson 5's 'check it yourself' line (instruction.md:13) is a process request, not a product deliverable. Lessons 15/19 (restart, scripted golden harness) are present and hash-bound. ADVERSARIAL: looked for a plausibly incomplete reference (no Activity job filter, no undo of reject/reopen, drafts shared across users, candidate auto-opened conversation, missing remaining-count on paging) and found none. A conforming alternative cannot fail this row because it grades only the reference. Non-defect observations: the stale-move refusal names who through the latest activity line text rather than a dedicated field; there is no polling fallback if SSE is blocked (SSE is explicitly allowed).
